description: This file defines a React context-based ThemeProvider component that manages light/dark theme state, synchronizes with localStorage and the HTML element classes, and provides a hook for accessing theme controls.

methods.name: ThemeProvider
methods.description: React component that provides theme state and toggle/set functions, initializes theme from local storage, and updates HTML class accordingly.

methods.name: useTheme
methods.description: Custom hook to access theme context, throws an error if used outside ThemeProvider.
